confidence_notes: The food anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living sources found through web search (citycost.org, traveltables, expatistan, livingcost.org). Those sources disagree and use different dates. The INR prices were converted to USD at about 88-94 INR per USD. A restaurant draft beer is set above the cheap-pub figures because Rajasthan beer is taxed heavily and served at a markup in restaurants. No direct aggregated prices were found for cocktails or wine. Those two are estimated from their usual price ratio to beer in Indian restaurant bars. Imported and Indian wine is heavily taxed, so the wine estimate is uncertain. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates based on general knowledge, not live listings. July is low season in Jaipur because of the monsoon, so July rates tend to be lower.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Indian tourist cities of similar size, such as Udaipur, Agra and Varanasi, with an adjustment for Jaipur's slightly higher upscale-tourism prices.
